SEE: ECONOMIC AFFAIRS (GEN.) outline for living standards and living conditions, including prices, cost of living, land use and reform, etc. AID outline for technical assistance aspects of community or rural development projects. REFUGEES & MIGRATION outline for refugees, escapees, and displaced persons as a social welfare problem. HEALTH & MEDICAL CARE outline for international health program, public health services provided to improve and protect health of the population, and medical assistance rendered in epidemics. CULTURE outline for a nation's culture, cultural development and conflicts, etc. EDUCATION outline for educational levels, trends, and development. LABOR & MANPOWER outline for matters regarding social security, retirement and pensions.

They also document party organization and leadership through plans to revise the statutes and convene a further meeting, as well as statements by the party’s vice president on U.S. influence and the apparent limits of support for that position. The material belongs to the early institutional history of the MDB under the military regime, when it operated as the authorized opposition party alongside the governing Aliança Renovadora Nacional (ARENA).
